title: [Master]-Sales Order line quantities are incorrectly updated after posting a Return Order linked to a Posted Sales Invoice via Applies-to Doc. No. on a Credit Memo.
summary: Posting a return order that is linked to a posted sales invoice through Applies-to Doc. No. on a credit memo no longer updates the original sales order line quantities incorrectly. The fix is in Correct Posted Sales Invoice for the W1, APAC and ES layers, with new tests.
key_points: Fixes issue where return order posting incorrectly adjusted sales order line quantities
Involves credit memo applies-to document links to posted invoices
Changes made to correct posted sales invoice codeunit across regions
Added test coverage for the purchase/sales copy document scenario
